hosts.name: Michael
hosts.text: On your turn: Flip a Host card in a player's Choir Facedown. It turns face up after the Reaping, or sooner if its owner pays 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Wisdom
hosts.text: On your turn: Look at the top card of the Host deck. You may discard it.

hosts.name: Gabriel
hosts.text: On your turn: Look at the top card of the Event deck, then return it.

hosts.name: Providence
hosts.text: In the Evening: Before Setting the Tide, you may pay 1 Glory to exchange 1 face-up card on the Altar with 1 card from your Choir.

hosts.name: Confession
hosts.text: On your turn: Reveal your hand to the table and keep it revealed until the end of your next turn. If it holds no Dark card, gain 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Tree of Life
hosts.text: On your turn: Take the top card of the discard pile into your hand, then discard a card from your hand.

hosts.name: Free Will
hosts.text: Once per game: Take two actions on your turn instead of one. Neither may be Turn.

hosts.name: Seraphim
hosts.text: On your turn: Choose 1 other Light Host card in your Choir and activate its ability a second time.

hosts.name: Hymn
hosts.text: You may Offer up to 2 Light Host cards to the Altar. If you Offer 2, place them face up. You gain only one reward.

hosts.name: Raphael
hosts.text: When you Offer a Light Host card, you may turn it face up and forgo its reward to destroy 1 face-up Dark card on the Altar.

hosts.name: Sanctuary
hosts.text: On your turn: Choose 1 card on the Altar. For the rest of this Day, it cannot be Gathered or destroyed by other players.

hosts.name: Uriel
hosts.text: At the Reaping: You may pay 1 Glory to make the Light Offering values in your Choir count double when calculating your Alignment.

hosts.name: Martyr
hosts.text: At the Reaping: If you lose Glory, replace any card in your Choir with a card from your hand.

hosts.name: Covenant
hosts.text: On your turn: Forbid Offer or Gather and name another player who has not yet taken their turn this Day. Neither of you may take that action before the next Evening. If the pact holds, you each gain 1 Glory in the Evening; if either of you breaks it, you each lose 1.

hosts.name: Tribute
hosts.text: Other players must pay 1 Glory to the Pot before they may Target any card in your Choir with an ability.

hosts.name: Mercy
hosts.text: Once per game: Choose to activate this card on your turn. You do not lose Glory at this Evening's Reaping.

hosts.name: Revelation
hosts.text: Once per game: Reveal your Fate token to all players, then gain 2 Glory. This cannot be used on Day 6.

hosts.name: Cherubim
hosts.text: Your Host cards cannot be Replaced or Discarded by other players' abilities. They may still be Copied or Flipped.

hosts.name: Morning Star
hosts.text: At the Reaping: You may pay 1 Glory to treat 1 Host card in your Choir as the opposite alignment for this Reaping. Neutral cards are unaffected.

hosts.name: Absolution
hosts.text: Once per Day: When a Host card is discarded from your Choir, you may return it to your hand instead, then discard 1 card from your hand.

hosts.name: Knowledge
hosts.text: Once per game: Secretly look at another player's Fate token, then return it.

hosts.name: Deliverance
hosts.text: Once per game: Choose any two players and exchange 1 Host card between their Choirs.

hosts.name: Vessel
hosts.text: On your turn: You may place a card from your hand on the Altar facedown, then gain 1 Glory or draw 1 card, as with an Offer. This is not an Offer.

hosts.name: Eternity
hosts.text: In the Evening: You may take 1 card from the Altar into your hand.

hosts.name: Ordeal
hosts.text: On your turn: You may invoke this card. At this Reaping, double the Glory you gain or lose from your Choir's Alignment.

hosts.name: Raguel
hosts.text: When this enters your Choir, choose another player. They are Bound to you while it remains. At each Reaping, if you lose Glory, your Bound player loses 1 Glory, and you lose 1 less.

hosts.name: Twilight
hosts.text: In the Evening: If your Choir holds at least one Light and at least one Dark Host card, gain 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Zealot
hosts.text: In the Evening: If your Choir has the single most extreme net Alignment at the table (no ties), gain 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Stillness
hosts.text: At the Reaping: If the Tide is Neutral (a tie or an empty Altar), gain 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Shroud
hosts.text: This card's Alignment mimics the opposite of the previous Day's Tide. If the last Tide was Light, it counts as Dark +2. If it was Dark, it counts as Light +2. If it was Neutral, or on Day 1, this card is Neutral.

hosts.name: Nephilim
hosts.text: This card counts as both Light +1 and Dark +1 at once. It satisfies any effect requiring a Light card and any requiring a Dark card. For your Alignment and the Tide, its two values are Neutral.

hosts.name: Firmament
hosts.text: At the Reaping: If the Tide's winning margin is exactly 1, gain 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Moderation
hosts.text: In the Evening: If your Choir's Alignment is Neutral, gain 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Fig Leaves
hosts.text: At the Reaping: You may treat your entire Choir's Alignment as Neutral, gaining and losing nothing.

hosts.name: Flaming Sword
hosts.text: While this card is face up in a Choir or on the Altar, no one may execute a Turn.

hosts.name: Outcast
hosts.text: When you Exalt, if you have the lowest Glory at the table or are tied for lowest, you pay no Glory. At the Reaping, if you have the lowest Glory or are tied for it, gain 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Heresy
hosts.text: At the Reaping: You may score your Alignment in reverse. Gain Glory equal to your net Alignment if it opposes the Tide; lose that much if it matches.

hosts.name: Council
hosts.text: On your turn: You may replace another card in your Choir with a card from your hand. Then each other player may do the same by paying you 1 Glory. Replaced cards are discarded.

hosts.name: Mirage
hosts.text: Your facedown Offerings cannot be flipped, looked at, exchanged, or destroyed before the Evening. At the Reaping, if a card you Offered facedown is still on the Altar and matches the Tide, gain 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Veil
hosts.text: Other players' abilities cannot Look at, Reveal, Copy, or Flip your cards or Fate. Your cards may still be Replaced or Discarded.

hosts.name: Prophecy
hosts.text: During the Unveiling: Publicly declare a Target Alignment, Light or Dark. At the Reaping, if the Tide matches, gain 1 Glory; otherwise, including a Neutral Tide, lose 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Watchers
hosts.text: On your turn: Look at the top 3 cards of the Host deck. Put 1 into your hand and discard a card from your hand, then return the rest in any order.

hosts.name: Apple
hosts.text: At the Reaping: If your Choir's Alignment is the opposite color from the previous Day's Tide, gain 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Forger
hosts.text: When you Gather, you may take any Host card from the discard pile instead of a card from the Altar or the deck.

hosts.name: Anathema
hosts.text: On your turn: Choose a player. They cannot take the Offer action until the start of your next turn.

hosts.name: Serpent
hosts.text: On your turn: Look at another player's hand, then you may exchange 1 card from your hand for 1 card in theirs.

hosts.name: Favor
hosts.text: When you Gather, you may instead take 1 card from a player's hand, either at random or 1 they choose to give you. They draw 1 from the Host deck.

hosts.name: Temptation
hosts.text: When you Gather from the top of the deck, look at the top 2 cards. Add 1 to your Choir as the Gather and 1 to your hand, then discard 1 card from your hand.

hosts.name: Legion
hosts.text: On your turn: Choose 1 other Dark Host card in your Choir and activate its ability a second time.

hosts.name: Lamentation
hosts.text: You may Offer up to 2 Dark Host cards to the Altar. If you Offer 2, place them face up. You gain only one reward.

hosts.name: Azazel
hosts.text: When you Offer a Dark Host card, you may turn it face up and forgo its reward to destroy 1 face-up Light card on the Altar.

hosts.name: Moloch
hosts.text: On your turn: You may discard 1 other Host card from your Choir to gain 1 Glory. Its ability must not have been used this turn.

hosts.name: Beelzebub
hosts.text: At the Reaping: You may pay 1 Glory to make the Dark Offering values in your Choir count double when calculating your Alignment.

hosts.name: Leviathan
hosts.text: At the Reaping: If your Alignment did not gain you Glory, gain 1 Glory if any other player loses Glory this Reaping.

hosts.name: Hubris
hosts.text: At the Reaping: If the player with the most Glory gains Glory this Reaping, they give 1 of that gained Glory to you.

hosts.name: Belial
hosts.text: When any player executes a Turn, every player except you loses 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Mammon
hosts.text: Once per Day: When you Offer a Dark card, take 1 Glory from a player of your choice instead of the Pot; or when you Exalt, pay the Glory cost to the player, other than you, with the least Glory.

hosts.name: Envy
hosts.text: On your turn: If the player with the most Glory has at least 3 more Glory than you, they lose 1 Glory. Each tied leader loses 1.

hosts.name: Lilith
hosts.text: You cannot be Targeted by Raguel, Covenant, or Scapegoat. On your turn, you may dissolve any pact or bond that includes you.

hosts.name: Parasite
hosts.text: This card cannot be voluntarily discarded or replaced when you Gather or Exalt. It has no ability and occupies a Choir slot. It leaves your Choir only when your or another player's effect moves it.

hosts.name: Winnowing
hosts.text: On your turn: Choose another player and discard 1 random card from their hand. They draw 1 from the Host deck.

hosts.name: Silence
hosts.text: Once per game: As another player activates a Host or Celestial ability, negate it. It has no effect, and any cost paid is not refunded.

hosts.name: Scapegoat
hosts.text: Once per game: Choose a player. If you would lose Glory at this Day's Reaping, they lose it instead. You lose nothing.

hosts.name: Defiance
hosts.text: Once per game: Choose to activate this card on your turn. Ignore the effects of the current Day's Event for yourself until the end of the Day.

hosts.name: Bounty
hosts.text: Once per game: Name a player and a Fate. At the endgame reveal, if you guessed their Fate correctly, gain 2 Glory.

hosts.name: Abaddon
hosts.text: Once per game: Choose to activate this card on your turn. Discard every card on the Altar and replace each with the top card of the Host deck.

hosts.name: Remnant
hosts.text: Before the Altar is Refreshed: You may take 1 card from the Altar into your hand, then discard 1 card from your hand.

hosts.name: Jubilee
hosts.text: On your turn: You may discard any number of cards from your hand, then draw back up to your hand limit.

hosts.name: Snare
hosts.text: When another player Gathers a card you Offered this Day, gain 1 Glory.

hosts.name: Ithuriel
hosts.text: On your turn: Flip one facedown card on the Altar face up.

hosts.name: Urim
hosts.text: On your turn: Secretly look at up to 3 facedown cards on the Altar.

hosts.name: Asmadai
hosts.text: On your turn: Look at one facedown card on the Altar. You may exchange it with a card from your hand. The new card stays facedown.

celestials.name: The Tempest
celestials.text: Once per Day, destroy one Host card from the Altar.

celestials.name: The Oracle
celestials.text: Once per Day, during the Unveiling, look at the top Event card. Play it, or bury it at the bottom of the deck.

celestials.name: The Eclipse
celestials.text: In the Evening, before the Altar is revealed, once per Day, treat one Host card in your Choir as Neutral for this Day's Reaping.

celestials.name: The Cantor
celestials.text: During your turn, you can Offer 2 cards to the Altar instead of 1, with a reward for each.

celestials.name: The Patron
celestials.text: Once per Day, give a Host card from your hand to another player. If their Choir is full, they discard a card to make room.

celestials.name: The Echo
celestials.text: Once per Day, copy the ability of a Host currently in another player's Choir.

celestials.name: The Dominion
celestials.text: Your hand limit is 4 instead of 3. Begin the game with 4 cards in hand.

celestials.name: The Whisper
celestials.text: During the Unveiling, publicly predict the direction of the Tide. At the Reaping, if correct, your Choir scores as if aligned with the Tide.

celestials.name: The Arbiter
celestials.text: At the Reaping, if you gain 2 or more Glory, take 1 of it from a player of your choice. If you lose Glory, give 1 of it to the player, other than you, with the least Glory.

events.name: Creation
events.text: During the Unveiling, reveal 3 Host cards as Seed to the Altar instead of 1.

events.name: Manna
events.text: Each player draws 1 card; hand limits increase by 1 this Day. Discard back to your limit in the Evening.

events.name: Ascension
events.text: Light Offerings count double when Setting the Tide.

events.name: Let There Be Light
events.text: The abilities of Dark Host cards in Choirs do not work this Day, including abilities that work on their own. The cards still count toward Alignment. Neutral cards are unaffected.

events.name: The Sabbath
events.text: The Balance marker does not move this Day. The Reaping still occurs.

events.name: Divine Calling
events.text: Exalt costs 0 Glory this Day.

events.name: Dispersion
events.text: Each player passes their entire hand to the player on their left.

events.name: Equilibrium
events.text: During the Unveiling, move the Balance marker 1 space toward the center. No effect if it is already on the center space.

events.name: Purgatory
events.text: This Day, ignore the Tide during the Reaping. Each net-Neutral Choir gains 1 Glory; each Aligned Choir loses 1 Glory.

events.name: Casting Lots
events.text: Each player secretly predicts the Tide during the Unveiling: Light, Dark, or Neutral. At the Reaping, a correct call gains 1 Glory (2 for Neutral); a wrong call loses 1.

events.name: Pandemonium
events.text: The Seed and First Fruits are placed facedown, and no card on the Altar may be flipped or looked at before the Evening.

events.name: False Prophecy
events.text: Set the Tide and move the Balance marker as normal. During the Reaping, score as if the Tide ran the opposite direction.

events.name: Famine
events.text: The Reaping is skipped. No Glory is gained or lost from Choir Alignment. All other scoring is unaffected.

events.name: Babel
events.text: No table talk, deals, or Glory transfers this Day.

events.name: Fall From Grace
events.text: Dark Offerings count double when Setting the Tide.

events.name: Armageddon
events.text: The Balance marker may move up to 3 spaces this Day.

events.name: The Plague
events.text: Each player discards 1 Host card from their Choir and replaces it from the top of the deck.

events.name: Tithe
events.text: Pay 1 Glory for each Host ability you activate this Day.

events.name: The Flood
events.text: The abilities of Light Host cards in Choirs do not work this Day, including abilities that work on their own. The cards still count toward Alignment. Neutral cards are unaffected.

events.name: The Fast
events.text: No Glory may be spent this Day. Exalt and Turn are unavailable.
